shortDescription: Paraguay is sending more beef to the US, but it has not been assigned an export quota like the one the Trump administration set for Argentina, President Santiago Peña said in a Bloomberg Television interview Friday in New York, according to Bloomberg.

title: GEOPOLITICS | Paraguay Boosts Beef Shipments to US, Peña Says
